info.name: Skincare Advisor API
info.description: Every endpoint, with SRS checks. Run scripts/make_postman_env.py first to create fresh test users, then select the 'Skincare Advisor - local' environment. Run the folders in order; the last folder deletes the test users.

exec: pm.test("limitations statement verbatim (FR-ONB-007)", () => pm.expect(b.limitationsStatement).to.include("not a medical device"));
pm.test("no review claim without a record (FR-ONB-008)", () => pm.expect(b.reviewClaim).to.include("published clinical guidelines"));
pm.test("no claim without a signed record", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.substantiated).to.be.false; pm.expect(b.reviewer).to.be.null; });
